reasons: Prerequisites for CS4230, CS4430, and CS4262 cannot be satisfied simultaneously in the remaining semesters.

CS4230 requires CS3230 (met) and ST2334/ST2131/MA2216/MA2116/MA2116T; student has ST2334, so CS4230 is eligible. However, CS4430 requires CS3231, which is not completed and has prerequisites CS1231/CS1231S/MA1100T/MA1100 AND CS2040/CS2040S/CS2040C/CS2040DE/CS2040HS. Student has CS1231S and CS2040S, so CS3231 is eligible. CS4262 requires CS2106/CG2271 (met) and CS3244/CS3264/CG3201. Student has none of these. CS3244 requires EE2012A/EE2012/YSC2243/ST2131/ST2334/MA2116/MA2116T/MA2216 AND (MA1511/MA1512) OR (MA2001/MA1522/MA1508E/MA1311/MA1513/MA1101R) AND (MA2002/MA1521/MA1505/MA1507/MA1102R). Student has MA1521, ST2334, MA1522. But CS3244 also requires (MA1511 and MA1512) OR ... The second part is met by MA1522. The first part (MA1511 and MA1512) is NOT met. The alternative is MA2001/MA1522/MA1508E/MA1311/MA1513/MA1101R. Student has MA1522. So the first part is met by MA1522? No, the prerequisite is (A and B) or C. A=(MA1511 and MA1512). B=(MA2001 or MA1522 or MA1508E or MA1311 or MA1513 or MA1101R). C=(MA2002 or MA1521 or MA1505 or MA1507 or MA1102R). Student has MA1521 (C is met). So CS3244 is eligible. CS3264 requires CS2109S (met) and CS2040/CS2040S/CS2040C/CS2040DE/CS2040HS (met) and MA1101R/MA1311/MA1513/MA1508E/MA2001/MA1522 (met by MA1522) and EE2012A/EE2012/ST2131/MA2116/MA2116T/ST2334/MA2216 (met by ST2334). So CS3264 is eligible. CG3201 requires EE2211 or EE2213. Student has neither. So CS4262 can be taken if CS3244 or CS3264 is taken. CS3244 and CS3264 are mutually exclusive with each other? No. CS3244 mutually exclusive with CS3264? Yes, 'mutually exclusive with: ... CS3264 ...'. So student must take either CS3244 or CS3264. CS3244 is offered Sem 1, Sem 2. CS3264 is offered Sem 1, Sem 2. Student is in Sem 7. Sem 7 is odd. Sem 8 is even. CS3244/CS3264 can be taken in Sem 7. CS4262 requires CS3244/CS3264. So CS4262 can be taken in Sem 8. CS4430 requires CS3231. CS3231 is offered Sem 1. It is NOT offered in Sem 7 or 8. Therefore, CS3231 cannot be taken. Consequently, CS4430 cannot be taken. Thus, no plan exists.
